title: XR App Data
description: Canonical schema for an application record shared by xr-lab-library and xr-lab-catalogue.

id.description: Stable slug, e.g. 'vermillion'. Used as the merge/dedupe key and for deep links. Do not reuse an id for a different app.

developer.description: Studio/publisher. Not populated in the migrated data yet -- needs backfill.

licensing_model.description: 'consumer' = buy normally on a Meta account like any Quest Store app, no EDU license or MDM needed. 'institutional' = requires a direct institutional/business relationship with the vendor (subscription, quote, or custom contract) rather than a standard store purchase. Note: as of Feb 20, 2026 Meta discontinued paid Quest for Business/Education bundles -- Horizon Managed Services (MDM/fleet management) is now free and usable with consumer hardware, and is an IT deployment choice, not an app-licensing requirement.

screenshots.description: Relative paths under images/apps/. First entry is the primary/cover image (formerly 'logo').

videos.description: Per-app demo/trailer video URLs. Empty until backfilled -- distinct from data/videos.json, which is a separate curated video collection, not per-app media.

durable_skills.description: Transferable skills this app builds. Library-originated enrichment; may be empty for catalogue-only apps.

approved.description: Approved for XR Lab use. Descriptive status, not a visibility gate.

installed.description: Currently installed in the XR Lab. Descriptive status, not a visibility gate.

library.description: Show on xr-lab-library. True only if the app is approved and/or installed.

catalogue.description: Show on xr-app-catalogue. True for anything in the XR ecosystem worth tracking, owned or not.
